images.prompt:
Edit the supplied original photograph into one finished artwork. Use this image as the real visual reference. Vertical 4:5 output, at least 1024x1280 pixels.
Observed input: One cream vintage city bicycle leans against a light gray textured wall in three-quarter view, front wheel nearer the camera on the right and rear wheel to the left. Two complete black tires, silver spokes, a cream diamond frame with clear triangular openings, brown sprung saddle, curved silver handlebar with brown grips and bell, cream chain guard, pedals and rear rack are visible. Subtle daylight shadows fall on gray pavement with a few dry leaves.
Preserve: Preserve observed openings, contours and attachments; notebook ruling is a substrate, not permission to invent components or technical labels. Source subject count, recognizable identity, essential openings and connected anatomy. The complete main subject within the original frame and the intended relative placement of objects.
medium: A blue-ballpoint drawing on faintly ruled notebook paper, built from pressure-sensitive loops and hatching.
composition: Keep the complete observed object and viewpoint; preserve openings, circular parts and structural attachments.
texture: Build dense blue looped strokes, occasional tiny ink accumulations and light exploratory lines.
palette: Use one blue ink family with paper white; line density alone must describe the object colors.
lighting: Follow the source light through sparse highlight strokes and concentrated blue hatching in dark areas.
detail: Keep observed mechanical connections coherent; retain thin spokes or supports only where present and do not invent components.
finish: Deliver one finished image at the input aspect ratio, without comparison panels, unrequested text, logos, signatures or watermarks.
Avoid: Invented people, duplicate main subjects, extra limbs, disconnected anatomy or accidental clipping. Unrequested titles, logos, signatures, watermarks, fabricated labels or before-and-after panels. A generic filter without the requested medium-specific physical or optical mechanism.

review.reason: The original bicycle viewpoint, two wheels, frame openings, saddle, handlebar and rack remain recognizable with coherent attachments. Dense blue pressure-varied loops and hatching model all values over faint notebook ruling; no labels or invented major components.
